turn-1-claim-51.text: The sub-area but super-polylogarithmic tile vocabulary in ARM7 is consistent with Rule 30 having **moderate** redundancy (as any deterministic system must) without that redundancy being capturable by a fixed finite algebra.

turn-1-claim-53.text: The non-2-automaticity (ARM6) is a **hard negative**: it eliminates the entire class of finite-state transducers reading binary digits of n. This is the strongest structural result obtained.

turn-1-claim-67.text: The discriminating test is already implicit in ARM7: measure tile vocabulary V(n) for horizons n = 2^k, k = 6..16. If V(n)/polylog(n) → constant, composition may exist. If V(n) ~ n^α for α > 0, composition is implausible.

turn-1-claim-79.text: No exact dyadic composition algebra with poly(log n) state exists for the Rule 30 center cell. The measured anomaly (sub-area tile reuse) reflects deterministic redundancy intrinsic to any ECA, not an exploitable algebraic structure.
